title: Valuation in Depressed Mood, Anhedonia, and Anxiety
official: Evaluating Overlap and Distinctiveness in Neurocomputational Loss and Reward Elements of the RDoC Matrix
summary: This study examines how people respond to rewards and losses, and the extent to which these responses are linked or distinct among people experiencing depressed mood, anhedonia, and/or anxiety.
conditions: Neurobehavioral Components of Reward and Loss Valuation
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* mood, anxiety, or anhedonia symptoms that affect functioning; fluent in English; able to see computer display; able to perform simple computer games.

Exclusion Criteria:

* history of seizure disorder, stroke, or head injury with more than 10 minutes of unconsciousness; hormone disorder; electroconvulsive therapy within 5 years; history of chemotherapy for cancer; current pregnancy; contraindications to MRI
sponsor: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University

sites.f: Fralin Biomedical Research Institute at Virginia Tech Carilion
